lines.lyric_translation: The light of my future is dimming

lines.lyric_hangul: 치기 어린 사랑에 잃은 꿈의 길
lines.lyric_translation: Because of my childish love, / I lost my way on a path of dream

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 야망의 독기 매일 칼을 갈았지
lines.lyric_translation: The venom of my ambition, / I sharpened my knife every day

lines.lyric: But chameul su eopneun nae yokshime
lines.lyric_hangul: But 참을 수 없는 내 욕심에
lines.lyric_translation: But because of my uncontrollable greed,
My knife became dull / I know it all

lines.lyric_hangul: 이 사랑은 악마의 또 다른 이름, 손을 잡지 마
lines.lyric_translation: This love is another name for the devil / Don’t hold her hand

parts.lyric: I sarangeun akmae tto dareun ireum

lines.lyric_translation: I shouted but turned away from my conscience
I feel the sharp reality more every day
There’s red blood from being torn apart by reality

lines.lyric_hangul: 생각 못했지 그 욕심이 지옥을 부르는 나팔이 될 지는
lines.lyric_translation: I never thought that / The greed would become the trumpet heralding hell

parts.lyric: Geu yokshimi jiogeul bureuneun napari doel jineun

lines.lyric_translation: Breathe
My breath is getting shorter

lines.lyric: Dwiteullin hyeonshire nun gamneun maeil bam
lines.lyric_hangul: 뒤틀린 현실에 눈 감는 매일 밤
lines.lyric_translation: I close my eyes every night from twisted reality
The music box of tragedy echoes
But in order to be free from this crime

lines.lyric: Geugeol ijneun ge dangchoe pogiga andwae
lines.lyric_hangul: 그걸 잊는 게 당최 포기가 안돼, eh
lines.lyric_translation: It’s impossible to forget and give up
Because those lips were too sweet
I threw my future away because I was drunk on dating

lines.lyric: Kkaeeonago bol ttaen imi sabangen jiroe
lines.lyric_hangul: 깨어나고 볼 땐, 이미 사방엔 지뢰
lines.lyric_translation: When I woke up, I was surrounded by land mines

lines.lyric: Geondeuril su eopneun maeseoun juwie shiseondeul
lines.lyric_hangul: 건드릴 수 없는 매서운 주위의 시선들
lines.lyric_translation: Surrounded by people’s stares that can’t be touched
I shout for a miracle in this reality / (Rewind)
It was crazy good
I was an idiot addicted to sweetness
Yeah an idiot
I didn’t want to let go of the devil’s hand
